data.one_liner: Flutter package that provides customizable page transitions with an easy-to-use API.
data.what_it_does: Provides a variety of customizable page transition animations such as fade, slide, and scale. Supports integration with standard Navigator as well as routing packages like GoRouter and AutoRoute. It includes extensions for context-based navigation and handles custom durations, curves, and iOS swipe-back gestures.
use_when: You want custom, smooth page transition animations without writing custom PageRouteBuilder boilerplate
You are using GoRouter, AutoRoute, or standard Navigator and need custom page transition effects
avoid_when: You rely completely on native platform transitions and have no need for customized animations
strengths: Wide variety of transition types including Material 3 shared axis transitions
Convenient context extensions for clean navigation code
weaknesses: iOS swipe back gesture only works with rightToLeft and fade transitions
Adds overhead to routing configuration if deep customization isn't required
